evidence: Except as otherwise permitted by applicable law
verify your identity prior to accessing or changing your Personal Data
reason: The predicate conjoins law.permitted with NOT law.permitted, so it can never hold. It also makes 'prior to accessing or changing', the timing of identity verification, a trigger for rectification. The text grants rectification on request except where law otherwise permits.

evidence: This Service does not use these “cookies” explicitly
the app may use third-party code and libraries that use
reason: The text says the Service does not use cookies explicitly. Third-party code and libraries in the app use cookies to collect information for their own services. Naming the app as the cookie user assigns the practice to the wrong party.

evidence: you have legal rights to request from us the following
Stopping processing your personal data in certain circumstances
reason: Stopping processing is a right the user may request in certain circumstances. The condition text mentions the request, but the predicate keeps only the vague circumstance terms and omits the user-request trigger.

evidence: We use this information:
as necessary in order to provide the Websites and related Services to you
reason: Use of collected information to provide the Websites and related Services is supported. The attribute 'this information' is left unresolved; it refers to the listed form, usage, correspondence, social media, and cookie information.

evidence: These data of human faces can only be used on your device
we would not collect or store such information
reason: DENY collect is supported because face data stays on the device and is not collected. The attribute 'such information' is unresolved and should name face information.

evidence: we do NOT track user traffic performed inside the VPN tunnel such as: browsing history, traffic destination, search preferences
reason: The no-logs statement explicitly denies tracking user traffic inside the VPN tunnel, including search preferences. Polarity, action, attribute, and the tunnel scope match.

evidence: we will normally collect personal information from you only (i) where we need the personal information to perform a contract with you
reason: The text limits collection to contract necessity, legitimate interests not overridden by user rights, or consent. The disjunctive condition matches. The duplicated 'from' in the counterparty is a formatting slip.

evidence: In order to personalize these ads or content, we or a data partner may connect and/or share de-identified demographic or other data about you (received from third parties)
how to opt-out of these tracking and advertising services
reason: The company or a data partner may connect de-identified data received from third parties to personalize ads, and the text offers an opt-out of these advertising services. The actor 'we' is one stated alternative, and the purpose is kept.

evidence: Where necessary under applicable laws, we will process your personal data on the basis of your consent.
reason: For EU/UK advertising and marketing, consent is the basis where applicable law requires it. The predicate's law.required reads as processing required by law, a localized misreading that only narrows the ALLOW.

evidence: the legal basis for doing so may be our legitimate interest
to respond to your comments and questions and to provide customer service
reason: Use of personal data to respond to comments and provide customer service is listed, and the stated legal basis may be legitimate interest. The claim is supported.

evidence: The type of personal information that we will collect, and you voluntarily provide to us for this service include some or all of the following:
Email address
reason: Email address is listed among the personal information the company collects. Actor normalization to the company is harmless.

evidence: You have the right to request that personal information held about you is deleted.
In some cases, we may not be able to delete your personal information
reason: The user may request deletion, and the text notes that deletion may not be possible in some cases. The claim encodes deletion on request with that exception.

evidence: We may be required to share your information when required by law, court order, government or regulatory request
reason: Under the 'Law Enforcement and Legal Requests' heading, sharing is permitted when required by law or official request, or to protect rights, prevent harm or fraud, or respond to listed entities. The condition alternatives are preserved.

evidence: When a person applies for a job or enters into an employment contract with us, we may collect certain information
relevant record checks
reason: Collection of relevant record checks from job applicants or employees is supported, and the condition text states that scope. The empty predicate does not encode the applicant or employee condition.

evidence: Period for which we store your personal data: Until the deletion of artwork with the user's YouTube or Online Gallery account.
Period for which we store your personal data: Two (2) weeks after prize payment.
reason: The retention period applies to one processing purpose whose heading is cut off, and other purposes in the segment have different periods. The claim generalizes the period to all personal data.

evidence: In the event that a user identifies himself/herself as a child under the age of 13 through a support request or feedback, we will not collect, store or use
reason: DENY collect applies when a user identifies as under 13 through a support request or feedback. The predicate's redundant age term is harmless.

evidence: we need to access your clipboard locally on the device
reason: Clipboard access occurs locally when the user copies information to share or receives shared information, for benefit acquisition, event participation, and sharing. All fields match.

evidence: expressly authorize PSafe to share their names, personal data, and images for advertising and/or promotional purposes
reason: Winners and loyalty program participants authorize PSafe to share their names for advertising or promotional purposes without remuneration. The parties, data, purpose, and terms are stated in the text.

evidence: Integration with third party services (Google, Facebook, Huawei, Microsoft, Apple, Stripe, and more) may require exchange of information, such as username, open ID
reason: Integration with third-party services may require exchanging open ID. The actor is the integration feature, not a party; the exchanging party is the service operator. The Microsoft counterparty and the conditions are supported.

evidence: We hold and use various types of personal data about you, including
working hours
reason: Working hours are listed among the personal data the employer holds. Actor normalization to the policy owner is harmless.

evidence: When you launch any of our applications, we collect information regarding your device type
the device’s geo-location
reason: Device geo-location is collected when any application is launched. All fields match.

evidence: When you access or use the App, we automatically collect general information about you
including which purchases you make with both virtual and real currencies
reason: Purchases made with virtual and real currencies are collected automatically when the user accesses or uses the App. All fields match.

evidence: Zip or postal code, virtual items or currency in Games, transaction amounts, and purchase history.
Collect payment and maintain transaction history.
reason: In the California notice chart, virtual items or currency in Games are used to collect payment and maintain transaction history. The jurisdiction scope follows the section heading.

evidence: To undertake surveys for partners
Personal details; Demographic data; Device data; Data contained in survey responses
reason: The table row lists Tap Research, the purpose of undertaking surveys for partners, personal details among the data, and the period until consent is withdrawn. The claim reflects the row, although the column headers are not visible.

evidence: Unity Analytics is an analytics service provided by Unity Technologies ApS.
Personal Data processed: usage data and various types of Data
reason: Unity Technologies ApS provides the analytics service that processes usage data. Actor, attribute, and purpose match.

evidence: may have been collected and disclosed in the preceding 12 months
reason: 'In the preceding 12 months' is a lookback period for the collection disclosure. The predicate turns it into retention.days <= 360, a retention condition the text does not state. Jurisdiction and attribute are supported.

evidence: save a property via your account
reason: The segment is a fragment with no subject, data practice, or registration statement. It cannot determine who acts, what data is processed, or whether registration is a condition.

evidence: Where permitted under applicable laws, your personal data may be transferred to, stored, and processed outside of your jurisdiction.
reason: Storage outside the user's jurisdiction where law permits is supported. The actor is blank, although the passive sentence follows a statement that the company stores collected information in Singapore, so the actor is the company.

evidence: we need to obtain Passport number for NRI account
reason: The bank obtains passport numbers for NRI accounts as an example of complying with laws governing financial services. All fields match.

evidence: The IT Administrator is responsible for the devices management
IMEI and Serial Number data from fully managed devices (corporate owned)
reason: The IT Administrator, responsible for device management, has access to serial number data from fully managed corporate devices. All fields match.

evidence: subject to certain exceptions and limitations
right to correct inaccuracies
reason: Residents of certain states may request correction of inaccurate personal data, subject to exceptions and limitations. The claim encodes the residency scope, the request, and the exception.

evidence: This software may record information such as how often you use the application
and from where the application was downloaded
reason: The company's mobile analytics software may record where the application was downloaded. Attributing the recording to the policy owner is acceptable because the company uses the software and stores its data.

evidence: we will not process your location data for any other purposes but those explained in this Privacy Statement
reason: DENY processing of location data for purposes outside the Privacy Statement is stated. The exception and predicate direction are correct.

evidence: We collect and record Direct Marketing information when we add you to our marketing database or you request to change your direct marketing preferences.
reason: The claim restates the sentence, including both triggering events. All fields match.

evidence: we may collect and store data from your computer or device when you use our Services
reason: Storage of data from the user's computer or device when using the Services is stated. All fields match.

evidence: When You use Toca Boca World We will process personal data to cross promote other apps that we develop and publish.
We will only process the minimum amount of data to understand what other apps You have downloaded from Us on Your device.
reason: Processing personal data when the user uses Toca Boca World, to cross-promote other apps, is supported. The text limits it to the minimum data needed to know which of its apps are installed, so 'personal data' is broader.

evidence: Actions taken by you or your activity in our
which include the following: like, share, report, download, login history, search history, feedback
reason: The listed in-app actions are collected as user activity in the App. Placing the category label in the condition is harmless, and the use-app predicate fits.

evidence: When you log in to your Honor account for online shopping, software downloading, and service purchasing, we will ask you to provide necessary personal data, such as your name
reason: Name collection on login for online shopping, software downloading, and service purchasing is supported, and the condition text says so. The predicate keeps only the login event and drops these activities.

evidence: Our advertising suppliers utilize your personal data to tailor ads specifically for you.
reason: The claim restates the sentence. Actor, action, attribute, and purpose match.

evidence: If you download or use an ad-supported version of any of our Services, we may disclose your personal data to AdTech Providers to enable them to serve third-party advertisements to you within our Services.
reason: Disclosure to AdTech Providers is conditioned on downloading or using an ad-supported version, for serving third-party ads. All fields match.

evidence: Our advertising partners will also still use your device’s advertising ID to serve you with ads that may be less relevant to you
reason: Advertising partners still use the advertising ID to serve less relevant ads, for example for frequency capping, even after preferences change. Because the use continues regardless of the preference setting, the unconditional claim is supported.

evidence: Under applicable laws of your jurisdiction, you may have one or more of the rights to your personal information.
Provide you with information we collect about you
reason: Among rights that may apply under local law, the company provides users the information collected about them, exercisable by email or through app or device settings. The claim and its conditions match.

evidence: If that personal data has been shared with third parties, Elokence will inform these third parties of your request for erasure, to the extent that it is feasible.
reason: The claim restates the sentence, including the sharing condition and the feasibility limit. All fields match.

evidence: We use personal data to provide customer support, to improve our games, and to develop new games.
reason: Use of personal data for customer support, game improvement, and new game development is stated. All fields match.

evidence: We store and process information in the United States.
reason: Storage of information is supported, but the claim drops the stated storage location, the United States. The omission is localized and does not change whether storage occurs.

evidence: We may share your information with service providers
These third parties may use your information only as directed or authorized by us and in a manner consistent with this Privacy Policy
reason: Use limited to the company's direction and consistency with the policy is supported. The actor 'These third parties' is unresolved and should name the service providers.

evidence: Generally, we do not collect any PII from you when you download our Android applications.
we even don't have a Server to store such PII
reason: The company states it has no server to store PII, referring to PII not collected when apps are downloaded. DENY store is supported, but 'such PII' is unresolved and loses that scope.

evidence: To the extent Beresnev Games makes location enabled Services available and you use such Services, Beresnev Games may collect and process your location data to provide location related Services and advertisements.
reason: The claim restates the sentence, including the location-enabled service condition and both purposes. All fields match.

evidence: When we receive your withdrawal of consent, we will no longer process your corresponding personal data.
reason: DENY processing of the corresponding personal data after consent withdrawal is stated. All fields match.

evidence: they may use and collect anonymous data about the User's interests
To opt out of interest-based advertising and analytics, check your ad tracking settings
reason: Third-party ad companies may use anonymous interest data in free apps to select relevant ads, with an ad-tracking opt-out. The actor 'they' is unresolved and should name the third-party advertising companies.
